prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE 1536x1024 landscape 3:2 background image for a first-person fantasy castle exploration game.
Input image role: the attached one-bed maid bedroom is the MATERIAL AND ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE and the room to redesign. The user has now explicitly chosen a FOUR-PERSON MAIDS' BEDROOM with EXACTLY FOUR SEPARATE SINGLE BEDS, a shared household dormitory. Substantially enlarge and rearrange the room to accommodate four people comfortably. Preserve the inhabited castle identity: pale warm-gray limestone walls, substantial dark oak ceiling beams and wooden floorboards, sober dark oak furniture, restrained gothic carved details, natural linen and muted wine-red wool bedding, little aged bronze fittings, tall leaded pointed-arch windows and gentle natural daylight. Do not preserve the original one-person floor plan.
LAYOUT AND BED COUNT: exactly FOUR clearly identifiable normal adult SINGLE BEDS. Two beds stand along the LEFT side of the room and two along the RIGHT side, with distinct near and farther beds on each side. Each bed has its headboard against its respective side wall and its foot pointing inward toward the broad central aisle. All four beds must be visibly separate and readily countable, with one pillow, distinct headboard, mattress, blanket and footboard each. Exactly four sleeping places, not three, not five, no double beds, no bunk beds, no hidden fifth cot. Do not merge bed shapes, duplicate mattresses or conceal the farther beds behind a wardrobe. Use physically credible architecture and perspective. Room dimensions feel approximately 6.5 metres wide by 7.5 metres deep with a 3.1-metre beamed ceiling, for composition rather than a floor plan; comfortable inhabited servant quarters, not a cramped cell, hospital ward, barracks hall or luxurious guest suite. Keep about 1.5-2 metres of clear central walking space between opposing bed feet. Four complete bed silhouettes should be readable from the view.
CAMERA: standing in the entrance at human eye level about 1.55 metres, looking naturally into the room with a level gaze and a moderately broad 30mm-type field of view. The doorway is behind the camera and out of the picture. Do not use an overhead floor-plan view, aerial angle, impossible dollhouse cutaway or ultra-wide distortion. Near beds should fit in the frame; allow a small strip of floor before them. Show room depth and daylight at the far end.
SHARED AND PERSONAL FURNISHING: give each bed its own modest bedside shelf or small locker and a dedicated wooden storage chest tucked close enough not to block the aisle; personal storage is visibly distributed among four sleeping places. A shared small oak sewing/work table and TWO chairs sit at the bright FAR window, with a closed sewing box, a few neatly folded work linens and a simple jug of small flowers. Two compact shared oak clothes cupboards can occupy the far corners if the beds stay fully visible. Use small differences in a folded blanket, a plain ribbon, a book without readable text and a little cloth pouch to suggest individual everyday lives, with no people or named occupants. Bedding is clean natural linen with muted red, dusty rose, soft brown or sage wool accents coordinated into the same household style. All four beds have the same practical furniture quality. Clean, maintained, warm and restful, with modest craftsmanship and a few woven rugs. No status labels, numbers, ornate noble canopies or lavish four-poster beds.
ART DIRECTION: beautifully painted 2D Japanese anime / visual-novel background, matching an anime-styled castle garden. Clearly illustrated forms, controlled edge accents, simplified elegant material texture and grouped painted colours; restrained painterly detail rather than photographic stone grain, wood noise or a 3D render. Mature detailed environment art, not cartoonishly distorted or chibi. REALISTIC LIGHTING: coherent soft daylight from the tall leaded far window, warm afternoon illumination across wood, cooler ambient light in shadow, physically plausible cast shadows and contact shadows around beds, natural room volume and depth. The window stays bright with delicate outside foliage glimpses, without blowing out the room or making it gloomy. No glitter, magic glow or excessive bloom.
NAVIGATION: this bedroom is a branch endpoint. Entry is behind the viewer. NO visible onward doors, open passages, stairs, bathrooms, balconies, secret exits or additional rooms. Cupboard doors read unmistakably as furniture. No people, text, UI, arrows, hotspots, watermark, flags, heraldic banners, symbols or modern objects. Prioritize the clear count of FOUR separate single beds, usable personal storage and coherent shared-room architecture.
